cards.title: MINER
cards.concept: beaming bareheaded miner in a dusty grey work shirt, his swept-up short quiff and high clean hairline showing, a small brass lamp hooked to his shirt strap, pickaxe resting on his shoulder and a gleaming lump of ore held up proudly at his chest
cards.hook: Crypto-mining pun on his blockchain work, lit by his big enthusiastic grin.

cards.title: CHAIN APPRENTICE
cards.concept: cheerful bareheaded apprentice smith with his swept-up short quiff showing, in a plain leather apron with a heavy coil of freshly forged iron chain slung over one shoulder and soot on his sleeves
cards.hook: Blockchain: every chain starts with someone forging the first links.

cards.title: LEDGER CLERK
cards.concept: smiling bareheaded town clerk with his swept-up short quiff showing, in a grey waistcoat with a quill tucked behind his ear, hugging a thick iron-clasped ledger book to his chest
cards.hook: A blockchain is a ledger; he keeps the books that nobody can rewrite.

cards.title: FULL STACK PORTER
cards.concept: grinning bareheaded porter with his swept-up short quiff showing, in a canvas vest, a tall tower of neatly stacked wooden crates on a back frame rising behind one shoulder, off-centre, so the top of his head stays clear
cards.hook: Full-stack developer, literally carrying the whole stack.

cards.title: TOWN CRIER
cards.concept: jubilant bareheaded town crier with his swept-up short quiff showing, in a grey cloak, ringing a brass-grey hand bell beside his face and holding a rolled proclamation scroll
cards.hook: His upbeat builder energy, announcing every new block to the whole town.

cards.title: FORGE SMITH
cards.concept: bareheaded journeyman smith with his swept-up short quiff showing, in a heavy leather apron with green trim, a green-wrapped hammer propped on his shoulder and a warm forge glow on his grinning face
cards.hook: Founding engineer: he hammers the first version into shape.

cards.title: KEYMASTER
cards.concept: roguish locksmith in a green-lined leather jerkin with the hood pushed down onto his shoulders, his swept-up short quiff showing, jingling a big ring of ornate keys beside his cheek with a small iron lockbox at his chest
cards.hook: Blockchain runs on private keys; he holds the ring.

cards.title: BRIDGE BUILDER
cards.concept: bareheaded adventuring engineer with his swept-up short quiff showing, in a green leather harness with goggles slung around his neck, a rolled blueprint under one arm and a coil of rope with small wooden planks over his shoulder
cards.hook: Blockchain integration: he builds the bridges between apps and chains.

cards.title: BLOCK GOLEM TINKER
cards.concept: happy bareheaded tinkerer with his swept-up short quiff showing, goggles hanging around his neck and a green-patched work coat, with a tiny cube-bodied golem familiar with glowing green eyes perched on his shoulder
cards.hook: A builder at heart; even his sidekick is made of blocks.

cards.title: CHAINSMITH
cards.concept: bareheaded master chainsmith with his swept-up short quiff showing, in fitted teal-trimmed plate over a smith's apron, holding up a chain of glowing teal cube-shaped links that he is joining one to the next
cards.hook: Blocks linked into a chain, forged by hand: blockchain made physical.

cards.title: DRAGONSCALE KNIGHT
cards.concept: confident bareheaded knight with his swept-up short quiff showing and a wide grin, in gleaming teal dragon-scale armour with a scaled pauldron, a faintly glowing teal scale-pattern shield behind his shoulder, no helmet
cards.hook: Builds applications at scale, so he wears the scales.

cards.title: SPELL CONTRACTOR
cards.concept: sharp bareheaded spellcaster with his swept-up short quiff showing, in a teal-hemmed robe, unrolling a glowing teal contract scroll at his chest whose runes are signing and sealing themselves
cards.hook: Smart contracts: a contractor whose contracts execute themselves.

cards.title: RUNEFORGE MASTER
cards.concept: bareheaded runeforge master with his swept-up short quiff showing, in ornate dark armour with violet molten runes flowing up both forearms, a rune-etched hammer raised behind his head and violet anvil sparks swirling around him
cards.hook: Full-stack craft taken to mastery: every layer inscribed by his hand.

cards.title: CHAIN LIGHTNING
cards.concept: bareheaded battle mage with his swept-up short quiff showing and his wide open grin, eyes clear with a faint violet rim light, in a high-collared violet storm coat wrapped in a crackling violet aura, magenta chain lightning arcing from his hand through a string of floating glowing cubes behind him
cards.hook: Blockchain as a spell: power leaping block to block.

cards.title: GENESIS BLOCK TITAN
cards.concept: bareheaded forge titan with his swept-up short quiff showing, in gold and white regalia, beaming, holding a radiant golden genesis cube at chest height beside his face, a molten-gold halo and golden chains blazing out across a starry sky behind his head, face large and centred
cards.hook: Founding engineer of the genesis block: the builder who forges the first link of everything.
